notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}.
Each Shipwreck Dowser you control prowess ability triggers, giving each of them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Doppelgang, creating five token copies of Shipwreck Dowser and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Shipwreck Dowser tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
